# dsh-plugin-web-socks-proxy

DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 `web_fetch` 在访问境外网站时自动走本机代理（默认 `socks5h://127.0.0.1:7890`，即 Clash 默认混合端口），其余站点保持直连。

**v1.1.0 起，代理在「设置 → 通用设置 → 网络代理」里随时可改**，无需动配置文件：

- **范围**：按域名自动分流（默认）/ 全部走代理 / 直连（停用）；
- **协议**：`SOCKS5（远程解析域名）`（`socks5h://`，推荐）/ `SOCKS5（本地解析域名）`（`socks5://`）/ `HTTP CONNECT`（`http://`）；
- **地址与端口**：改完按回车或移出输入框即保存，立即生效（写入 profile 补丁层的 volatile 覆盖，热重载）。

`bypassDomains`（localhost、127.0.0.1、.cn、本机服务端点等）在任何模式下都保持直连。

## 工作方式

- 注册一个 id 为 `web-socks-router` 的 `WebFetchProvider` 到 `ctx.web`，并把 `web` 服务的 `fetchProvider` 指向它。
- 每一跳 URL 独立决策路由：
  - `mode: auto`（默认）：仅 `proxyDomains` 列表中的域名走代理（`bypassDomains` 优先级更高）；
  - `mode: always`：除 `bypassDomains` 外全部走代理；
  - `mode: never`：全部直连（插件仍在位，方便快速关闭）。
  - 以上三项即设置界面「网络代理」行的三个选项；`proxy` 与 `mode` 是 volatile 配置字段，界面写入后由 config-editor 持久化进 profile 补丁。
- 域名规则：裸域名 `google.com` 匹配自身及全部子域；`*.example.com` 只匹配子域。
- `socks5h://` 由代理端解析域名（推荐）；`socks5://` 本地解析后再连代理（会做公网地址校验）。
- 代理连接失败时报错 `WEB_PROXY_UNAVAILABLE`（提示检查本地代理客户端），不会静默直连泄露流量。
- 直连路径复刻了官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 的安全姿态：仅 HTTP(S)、拒绝 URL 内嵌凭据、解析结果全部校验为公网地址并锁定连接、仅跟随同源重定向、字节/字符上限、按 Content-Type/charset 解码。

## 附带能力

- 注册一段系统提示（`web-socks-proxy`，可用 `promptSection: false` 关闭），让 Agent 知道：
  `web_fetch` 会自动走代理；shell 命令需要代理时先设 `ALL_PROXY`（PowerShell：`$env:ALL_PROXY = 'socks5://127.0.0.1:7890'`；bash：`export ALL_PROXY=socks5://127.0.0.1:7890`），curl 也可以 `-x socks5h://127.0.0.1:7890`。

## 安装

桌面端「设置 → 插件」或插件管理器安装本目录（本地 file 包），安装后自动作为 bundle 加入 desktop profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。配置位于 bundle 自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`（插入行 id 为 `web-socks-proxy`），可在配置编辑器中直接修改。

## 卸载/回退

在插件管理器中停用或移除本 bundle 即可：随 bundle 注入的 `web` 行覆盖一并消失，基础层的 `fetchProvider: http` 自动恢复，行为回到原始直连。

## 故障诊断

超时/连接错误信息带有 `stage` 字段，指示停滞的阶段，例如：

- `tcp connect direct …` / `SOCKS proxy 127.0.0.1:7890 socks-greeting`：代理客户端未监听或不可达，确认 Clash 等本地代理在运行；
- `await-connect-reply …`：CONNECT 请求已发出但代理未回复（通常是代理端上游节点/规则问题）；
- `tls handshake …`：隧道已建立但 TLS 失败（一般是代理上游被干扰）；
- `http exchange …`：TLS 正常，等待 HTTP 响应。

超时错误同时附带 `trace`（SOCKS 帧读取的事件序列），可用于进一步定位。握手阶段停滞的错误里 `…ms since connect` 表示从 TCP 连上到超时的耗时。

## 开发

- 修改 `lib/index.js` 后，若 profile 补丁层将本目录加入了 hmr 的 `root` 监视列表（`- id: hmr / config: root: [<本目录>]`），改动会自动热重载；否则需重启 DeepSeek Harness 才会重新导入模块（启用/停用开关不会重新导入已缓存的 ESM 模块）。
- 仓库内另有两个独立诊断脚本（与插件无关，仅辅助排障）：`../socks-diag.mjs`（裸 SOCKS5+TLS 协议探测）与 `../provider-diag.mjs`（在宿主外直接运行 provider 代码）。

plugins.description: The Coreness kit for DeepSeek Harness — a plugin bundle for a profile.
plugins.readme_text:
# Coreness for DeepSeek Harness **A face, a memory and a brake for a DeepSeek Harness profile.** Coreness is one package a profile lives by. It brings the profile a page of its own in the application, keeps the journal of what the profile and its sessions do, gives the profile's MCP servers a face, holds a request the vendor would otherwise refuse, and adds a route to the Qoder models. It installs as it is: the halves the browser loads are plain files, served where they lie — nothing is built, nothing is compiled, and what is installed is what runs. ## ⚡ Install **The application installs its own plugins.** *Plugins* → *Add plugin* takes a package name, a tarball, a git address or a local path, and the package goes into the profile the application is running — one door for the desktop application and for the web one, and no profile to name: ``` github:Vensus137/Coreness-DSH ``` The same page switches the package off without removing it, and takes it off again. That address follows the newest release, and what stands published is a release — so the address and the newest release are one thing here. A fixed release is named by its own tag — `…Coreness-DSH#v0.3.0` — and a released tag is never moved: that line gives the same code whenever it is run.
By command line — for a terminal; nothing above needs it The line is ready to run as it stands, because the desktop application's own profile carries that name: ``` dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Vensus137/Coreness-DSH ``` Another profile is named by its own name instead — the web surface's is `web` — and naming a profile that does not stand yet creates it. `dsh` is the application's own command and is not one Windows or macOS comes with, so until the application puts it on the path a terminal answers *not recognized*. The application does that from its own menu: in the window's title bar beside the app icon, **Application** → **Manage dsh Command…** — the dialog shows the location it manages, and the same dialog takes the command off the path again. A terminal opened before that act keeps the path it started with, so open a new one afterwards.
The profile's composition is read when the application starts, so the package becomes live at the next start, and the platform says itself when a change it made needs a restart. Nothing is built on the way in and no permission for install scripts is asked: the package is plain files, the install takes the directories its manifest names and nothing else, and the address is fetched over the network the application already uses rather than by a git client — a machine without git installs it. ## ✨ What a profile gets - 🗂 **A page of its own** — the profile's overview: what it carries, which bundles and rows stand and which are off, and the settings a session or a plugin has to be told. - 🔌 **The MCP servers, seen and edited** — one card per server: its kind, its address, the environment it needs, and switches whose effect lands in the profile rather than in a copy. - 📓 **The journal** — the environment's memory: what changed in the profile and what a participant did, kept as records that carry a kind, an area, a name and an author. - 🚦 **A limiter that waits instead of refusing** — a call over the limit takes its turn in a queue; nothing is limited as the package ships. - 🧠 **A route to the Qoder models** — the account's own models, each with the reasoning levels it accepts and the output budget it allows. The account's token is entered once, on the page, and kept by the platform's own store; no value of it stands in the package. ## 🧩 What it needs - **DeepSeek Harness.** The version this package was built against is declared in the manifest, and the application compares that declaration with its own before a profile imports a plugin: a mismatch leaves the plugin out and says so, instead of failing quietly later. ## 📦 What lands Exactly the list the package's manifest names — the assembly and the plugins, each with its own README beside its code. No part of the workshop they are built in: the contracts, the checks and the notes of this project stay where the work is done. ## 🧭 What it deliberately does not do - It is not a second door to the platform's own acts: enabling, disabling, installing and removing belong to the application's Plugins page, and this package reports what stands rather than competing with it. - It does not own the MCP side: the platform owns the servers, the connection and the registry, while this package owns the picture and the form. - It limits nothing until a limit is declared. ## 📄 License MIT.

plugins.description: One-install ZadLoop toolkit: Context Surgery, Undo, mode switching, full session transfer, and 70 modern themes.
plugins.readme_text:
# ZadLoop Ultimate Toolkit **One tarball. Six integrated tools. No plugin hunting.** ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.2.0-7c8cff?style=flat-square) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-45c992?style=flat-square) ![ZadLoop](https://img.shields.io/badge/ZadLoop-0.5.1-ff7a90?style=flat-square) ![Offline bundle](https://img.shields.io/badge/install-offline_bundle-f4c45e?style=flat-square) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/Lucifer-xD/zadloop-ultimate-toolkit/ci.yml?style=flat-square&label=tests)](https://github.com/Lucifer-xD/zadloop-ultimate-toolkit/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
ZadLoop Ultimate Toolkit packages Computer Use, Context Surgery, same-session Undo, live session mode switching, full chat transfer, and Theme Studio into **one self-contained plugin file**. Its dependencies are bundled inside the release, so your friends install a single `.tgz` rather than finding separate packages. > Community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek or ZadLoop. ## What is included | Feature | What it does | Included version | |---|---|---:| | Computer Use | Let a vision-capable agent manage its own access and operate the visible Windows desktop with screenshots, mouse, keyboard, scrolling, and an expiring timer | 1.1.1 | | Context Surgery | Edit reply text, edit reasoning separately, remove messages from future model context, and use `/context` commands | 0.1.2 fixed-v4 | | Same-session Undo | Remove one user/assistant exchange from the transcript and future context without creating a new session | 1.5.1 | | Mode Switcher | Change the **current session** between Standard and Delegate mode | 2.0.3 | | Session Transfer | Export/import a complete chat with title, events, settings, subagents, files, and images | 1.0.2 | | Theme Studio | 50 dark + 20 light mode-exclusive themes, gradients, detailed controls, and a live preview | 5.0.3 | | Offline dependencies | Bundled runtime packages, including `fflate`; no npm lookup is required during tarball installation | bundled | ![Compact toolbar with Themes, Mode, and Transfer](docs/images/toolbar.svg) ## Install ### ZadLoop interface 1. Download [`dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit-1.2.0.tgz`](https://github.com/Lucifer-xD/zadloop-ultimate-toolkit/releases/latest/download/dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit-1.2.0.tgz) from the latest GitHub release. 2. If standalone copies are installed, disable or uninstall these first to avoid duplicate buttons: - `@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery` - `dsh-zadloop-undo` - `dsh-zadloop-mode-switcher` - `dsh-zadloop-computer-use` - `dsh-zadloop-theme-studio` - `dsh-zadloop-session-transfer` 3. Open **Plugins → Add plugin → Tarball**. 4. Select the downloaded toolkit `.tgz`. 5. Let ZadLoop hot-load it. Restart only if your ZadLoop build explicitly asks you to. ### Command line ```powershell cd "$env:APPDATA\ZadLoop\harness\profiles\web" pnpm add "C:\path\to\dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit-1.2.0.tgz" ``` Add `dsh-zadloop-ultimate-toolkit` once to `dsh.profile.bundles` if your package manager does not do that automatically. ## Feature guide ### Computer Use Ask for a desktop task naturally. The agent uses `computer_access` to enable control when needed, operates through screenshots, then can pause access when finished. **Computer** in the bottom dock still provides live status, manual 15–120 minute controls, and **Pause now** for terminating an in-flight action. Then ask naturally, for example: - “Open Settings and enable Night light.” - “Use the browser to download my latest invoice.” - “Open this spreadsheet and sort the table by date.” The model receives a new screenshot after every action and can move, click, double-click, right-click, drag, scroll, type Unicode text, and press shortcuts such as `CTRL+L` or `ALT+TAB`. Coordinates remain accurate on scaled and multi-monitor desktops. ![Computer Use control center](docs/images/computer-use.svg) Use a vision-capable model. Supervise consequential work and pause before passwords, payments, account changes, or other sensitive actions. ### Context Surgery Use the actions under an assistant message: - **Edit reply** changes visible reply text while preserving reasoning and tool calls. - **Edit reasoning** changes only the reasoning stream. - **Remove** shadows that message from the model-visible context through an append-only surface replacement. - `/context list`, `/context edit`, `/context think`, `/context clear-think`, `/context rewrite`, `/context delete`, and `/context replace` provide command-level control. ![Context Surgery and Undo example](docs/images/context-surgery.svg) Context Surgery is powerful: it changes what the model sees on its next request. The original durable log is retained for auditability. ### Same-session Undo Click **Undo** beside an exchange. The selected user message and its reply are removed from the visible transcript and future model context while the session ID stays unchanged. Undo does **not** reverse file edits, commands, deployments, or other external side effects. ### Standard ↔ Delegate mode The compact dock control shows the current and target mode, for example `Standard → Delegate`. Clicking it recomposes the existing live agent and records `agent-preset/selected`; it does not start a new session. ### Theme Studio Open **Themes** from the bottom dock. Choose from 70 mode-aware presets or tune typography, surfaces, accents, radii, density, shadows, gradients, and chat colors with an always-live preview. ![Theme Studio mockup](docs/images/theme-studio.svg) - Dark presets appear only in dark mode. - Light presets appear only in light mode. - Every preset recolors the background, panels, composer, messages, text, borders, and interactive states—not just the wallpaper. ### Transfer a complete chat 1. Open the chat you want to move. 2. Click **Transfer → Export complete chat**. 3. Copy the resulting `.zadloop-session.zip` to the other PC or RDP. 4. Install this toolkit there. 5. Click **Transfer → Choose transfer file** and select the ZIP. ![Session Transfer mockup](docs/images/session-transfer.svg) The archive preserves the session title and identity, model/mode/access events, full conversation, reasoning, tool calls/results, subagent sessions, files, and images. Import refuses to overwrite an existing session ID. Machine-wide credentials, API keys, provider logins, and global preferences are intentionally excluded. Configure those separately on the destination computer. ## Practical examples See [examples/WORKFLOWS.md](examples/WORKFLOWS.md) for complete workflows: - Correct a bad assistant answer without losing tool calls. - Undo a mistaken exchange and resend a corrected prompt. - Switch a long-running session between Standard and Delegate. - Move a session from a PC to an RDP. - Build matching dark and light visual profiles. ## Safety and privacy - No telemetry is added by this toolkit. - Session Transfer writes only to local ZadLoop session/attachment storage. - Imported archives are checked for traversal paths, encryption, ZIP64, entry count, compressed size, expanded size, valid JSONL, contiguous event sequences, duplicate session IDs, and attachment integrity. - Context edits and Undo are append-only. They change the model-visible surface rather than erasing the durable log. - Context Surgery exposes loopback-only local API routes. Any trusted local process can reach loopback, so use ZadLoop on a trusted machine. - Computer Use is Windows-only, starts paused after every host start or plugin reload, never persists an access grant, and exposes fixed desktop actions rather than arbitrary command execution. - The agent may enable or pause Computer Use through `computer_access`. Manual **Pause now** terminates an in-flight desktop action, while screenshots are stored by ZadLoop as normal session attachments for inspection. ## Compatibility Validated with: - ZadLoop 0.5.1 - DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 - Node.js 22.19 or newer - Windows desktop web profile The clean-profile s

plugins.description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness ⇄ JetBrains integration: DSH chat inside your IDE, and your IDE workspace — project, attached modules, active file and caret — in front of the model.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ⇄ JetBrains

Small packages that connect a local [DeepSeek Harness](../../) (DSH) to a JetBrains IDE, so the IDE and
the agent share one workspace instead of two islands.

Two of them are independent halves of one workflow, and each works on its own; the third lets a page be
asked for a session by address.:

| Package | Platform | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`jetbrains-companion/`](jetbrains-companion) | IntelliJ Platform plugin (Java, no Gradle) | **DSH Chat** tool window embedding DSH's own web client, one DSH session per IDE window, live workspace publication, and a loopback bridge so DSH can put a file in front of you. |
| [`jetbrains-workspace/`](jetbrains-workspace) | DSH profile bundle (plain JavaScript) | Reads the IDE's workspace — including a module's multiple content roots from its `.iml` — into DSH as a tool, a runtime context line, and a registered workspace. Works with the companion running or from the IDE's own state files after it closed. |
| [`jetbrains-session-link/`](jetbrains-session-link) | DSH client plugin (plain JavaScript) | Lets `#dsh-session=<id>` — or a hash change on an open page — select that session without a reload. Optional: the chat panel falls back to the client's stored selection when it is absent. |

> **Unofficial.** Neither package is made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with JetBrains or DeepSeek.
> IntelliJ, IDEA and JetBrains are trademarks of JetBrains s.r.o.

## What you get

- **Chat inside the IDE.** The `DSH Chat` tool window renders DSH's web client, authenticated with the
  same browser-session cookie DSH gives a browser, and opens the session for the window you are in.
- **One workspace, seen from both sides.** The window's root project and every attached module/VCS
  directory reach the model as a runtime context line and as a `jetbrains_workspace` tool result, with
  each directory labelled by the source that reported it.
- **Round trip.** DSH can read the active file, caret and selection, and open a file in the IDE at a
  line — with the companion's bridge, or with the IDE state files when the IDE is closed.

## What each half gives you

Each half is useful alone, and they do not depend on each other to install. What you get changes:

| Capability | IDE plugin only | DSH bundle only | Both |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DSH Chat` tool window in the IDE (embedded DSH client, cookie auth) | yes | — | yes |
| One DSH session per IDE window, grouped in the DSH sidebar | yes — the panel registers the workspace and creates or attaches the session itself | — | yes |
| The model knows which IDE window is open (runtime context line) | — | yes, from the IDE's state files, or live when the companion runs | yes |
| `jetbrains_workspace` tool: root project, module content roots, active file, caret, selection | — | yes | yes |
| `jetbrains_open_in_ide`: the model opens a file in the IDE | — | no — it needs the companion's bridge | yes |
| Session selected without reloading the page | no — it seeds the client's stored selection and reloads once | — | yes, with `jetbrains-session-link` |
| Change review of a turn (which files, and their diffs) | — | yes — publishes `<DSH home>/jetbrains-changes.json` with the coordinates DSH's own `/api/changes.*` routes need | yes |

So: install the **IDE plugin** to chat with DSH inside your IDE (it needs a DSH running locally, and
reads DSH's credential document to sign the browser cookie — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). Install
the **DSH bundle** to put your IDE workspace in front of the model. Install **both** for the round
trip, where the model can name the file you are editing and open another one for you.

The two halves talk through DSH's own HTTP API and the companion's descriptor
(`<DSH home>/jetbrains-companion.json`, carrying a `version` and a `source` marker), so either half can
be updated on its own: a bundle that finds no live descriptor falls back to the IDE's state files, and a
companion never requires the bundle to be installed.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/abadiegie/dsh-jetbrains.git
```

**1. The IDE plugin** (needs IntelliJ Platform build 243 or newer, with JCEF):

```sh
cd jetbrains-companion
./build.sh                 # compiles against the installed IDE and copies the jar into it
IDE_HOME=/path/to/idea ./build.sh
```

Then restart the IDE. Settings live under `Settings ▸ Tools ▸ DSH Companion`. Step 1 needs no DSH-side
plugin; installing it alone gives you the chat panel (see the table above).

**2. The DSH bundle** (needs a DSH profile):

```sh
# from a DSH session: install the bundle directory into the current profile
plugin_manager install_bundle /absolute/path/to/jetbrains-workspace
```

Then restart DSH. `jetbrains_workspace` and `jetbrains_open_in_ide` become available to the agent; step
2 needs no IDE plugin, because the bundle reads the IDE's state files when no companion is publishing a
descriptor. For the round trip — the model naming your active file and opening another — install both.

## Documentation

- [`jetbrains-companion/README.md`](jetbrains-companion/README.md) — the chat panel, session scope,
  discovery, settings, verification harnesses, limits.
- [`jetbrains-workspace/README.md`](jetbrains-workspace/README.md) — what it registers, where the data
  comes from, configuration, limits.
- [`jetbrains-session-link/README.md`](jetbrains-session-link/README.md) — the fragment contract, the
  marker a host reads, and what was verified in a browser and inside the IDE panel.
- [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) — what these plugins read and what they can do on your machine. Read
  this before installing.
- [`.dsh/skills/dsh-jetbrains/SKILL.md`](.dsh/skills/dsh-jetbrains/SKILL.md) — a DeepSeek Harness
  skill for agents editing this repository: the build and check commands, and the traps worth knowing
  first. DSH scans `<project>/.dsh/skills` (and `<project>/.agents/skills`) around the nearest
  repository root, so a clone carries it and it is live for the agent working in that clone.
- [`docs/PUBLISHING.md`](docs/PUBLISHING.md) — the checklist this repository was prepared against.
- [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md).

## Requirements

- A JetBrains IDE, build 243+ (`IC-243` or newer), with the bundled browser (JCEF).
- A JDK 21 toolchain for the IDE plugin build — the IDE's own JBR is enough.
- Node.js 20+ for the DSH bundle and its development checks.
- DSH from a version that exposes `workspace/create` returning `sessionIds` and `created`,
  `workspace/rename`, `session/create` with either `cwd` or `workspaceId` + `sessionId`, and
  `workspace/archiveSession` — the API surface both halves are written against.

## Development

```sh
# DSH bundle: schema, discovery, roles, workspace registration, runtime context
cd jetbrains-workspace && node dev/check.mjs

# IDE plugin: the IntelliJ-free half, the DSH client, the panel's auth path, address and scope rules
cd jetbrains-companion && ./build.sh
/usr/share/idea/jbr/bin/javac -cp build/stage -d build/check dev/*.java
/usr/share/idea/jbr/bin/java -cp build/stage:build/check Check
```

Every harness skips itself with a message when the DSH home, the server, or the IDE it needs is
absent, so a missing dependency never looks like a failure.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: DSH 微信通道增强插件 — 集成 iLink 消息双向桥接、单实例锁、大文件智能投递与 Web 设置管理界面
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-weixin-plus

> DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 微信通道全功能增强插件。

集成了手机微信与 DSH 之间的实时双向消息桥接、单实例选举守护锁、大文件本地智能投递与 Web 端原生设置管理面板。

---

## 核心特性

1. **双向消息与媒体桥接**：手机微信发消息直通 DSH 会话，支持文本与双向多媒体传输。
2. **Web 设置与管理面板**：
   - 嵌入 DSH 设置中心「微信通道」标签页。
   - 实时探测微信服务端连通性与 Token 有效期（过期即时预警）。
   - 内置一键重新扫码登录，动态渲染 Base64 二维码与直链。
   - 支持一键断开连接并安全清理本地凭证。
3. **免 403 健壮通讯**：
   - 首创基于 Cordis `connection.rpc` 通道双向通信，天然免疫 Electron 与常规浏览器模式下的安全拦截与 403 鉴权错误。
   - 优雅兼容 HTTP RESTful 路由回退。
4. **单实例选举锁 (ilink-owner.lock)**：
   - 防止多宿主（如 GUI 与后台无头服务）同时消费消息导致的游标竞争与丢消息问题。
5. **大文件智能转接 (filepush17)**：
   - 智能识别超过微信体积限制的本地文件并安全暂存。

---

## 安装与配置

在 DSH `cordis.patch.yml` 中启用：

```yaml
- id: weixin-plus
  plugin: ./node_modules/dsh-weixin-plus/index.js
```

并在 `package.json` 中引入依赖：

```json
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-weixin-plus": "github:liushQAQ/dsh-weixin-plus"
}
```

---

## 架构

- `index.js`: 宿主端逻辑，包括 iLink 轮询、会话挂载、单实例选举、Cordis RPC 与 WebServer 路由。
- `client.js`: 客户端 React 前端，挂载在 `settings.section`（id: `weixin`）。
- `cordis.patch.yml`: 插件装配声明。

plugins.description: DSH 宿主内哨兵：同步调用打点 + 主线程卡死取证 + 内存三闸（写闸 / 冷回填闸 / 闲置会话下放）+ 队列哨兵。零依赖，全中文。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-local-host-guard · DSH 宿主内哨兵

## 30 秒版

> **DSH 的宿主进程有两条命门：一次卡死的同步调用，和一个撞上 4 GB 堆顶的进程。**
> 这个插件就是给宿主配的随行医生 + 三层限流阀：卡死时它指名道姓说"卡在哪一行调用"；
> 内存快撞顶时它先把派生缓存、冷回填、闲置会话一层一层放掉。
> **零依赖（只用 node 内建）、全中文界面、默认只报告不动作。**

三句话讲完它的价值：

- 宿主**"莫名其妙断了"**（窗口还在、活儿全停、没有任何报错）→ `卡死报告` 里有最后那次"进入了、没返回"的同步调用，带完整命令行摘要；
- 宿主**"一开大会话就 OOM 退出"**（`FATAL ERROR: CALL_AND_RETRY_LAST`，退出码 134）→ 下放让闲置会话退出宿主 SessionStore，把活对象先降下来；崩前那些对象**连全量 GC 都收不掉**；
- 宿主**"越用越慢、磁盘狂转"**→ 写闸 / 冷回填闸 / 队列哨兵各自把住一条"一个动作放大成几十 KB"的链路。

## 安装

```bash
# 从 npm（包名已预留；发布后可用）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-local-host-guard

# 或直接从 Git 仓库装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/maozhuoshushu/dsh-local-host-guard
```

装好后在宿主里挂载；配置写在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\host-guard.json`（**没有这个文件就用内置默认值**，默认 `启用下放=true` 但 `下放动作="只报告"`，即"只观测、不动手"）。

> 下文里的 `D:\数据库\dsh闲杂工作区\...`、`D:\dsh\_audit\...` 是**作者本机的示例路径**：
> 插件所有路径都能在配置里改，默认值会退回 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\host-guard`。

---

## 它解决什么问题

2026-10-01 的"DSH 莫名其妙断了"事故复盘结论是：**宿主进程的事件循环被某次同步调用卡死**——
没有任何崩溃日志、没有报错，窗口还在，但活儿全停了。要根治，第一步不是"防"，而是**能说出卡在哪一次调用上**。

这个插件就干这件事：

| 功能（中文） | 干什么 | 卡死时能给你什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **同步调用打点** | 每次 `spawnSync` / `execFileSync` / `execSync` 调用前后各写一行流水（"进入" / "返回"） | **最后一次"进入了没返回"的调用，就是凶手**（带完整命令行摘要） |
| **同步调用限时** | 调用方没写 `timeout` 时补一个默认限时（默认 120 秒；`taskkill` 这类杀进程调用 10 秒） | 让"无限期挂在事件循环上"变成"最多挂 10 秒/2 分钟" |
| **慢调用日志** | 超过阈值（默认 3 秒）就记一条，哪怕最终成功了 | 事后回看"哪里一直很慢"，找趋势 |
| **主线程哨兵** | 独立 worker 线程盯着主线程心跳，停摆超阈值（默认 8 秒）立刻落盘 | 一份**卡死报告**：检测时间、停了多久、**当前卡住的同步调用**、最近流水、进程内存与 CPU，并附 node 进程报告 |
| **恢复补记** | 主线程活过来后往同一份报告里补"恢复时间 / 总停摆毫秒" | 知道每次卡死持续了多久 |

一句话：**下次再断，不用猜，直接看 `卡死报告` 说卡在哪。**

> 2026-10-05 追加了第二个本事：**内存下放**（见下文「内存下放」一节）。宿主堆上限固定 4192 MB，
> 撞顶就 `FATAL ERROR` 退出（退出码 134），而崩前那些活对象**连全量 GC 都收不掉**——
> 所以让"闲置但活着"的会话从宿主的 SessionStore 里退出去，是目前唯一有效的减活对象手段。
> 它默认**只报告不动作**。

---

## 为什么写成插件（而不是之前那两条路）

| 走过的路 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 启动器注入 `NODE_OPTIONS=--require ...` 预加载 | ❌ **物理上走不通**：打包版 Electron 在 GUI 主进程就把 `NODE_OPTIONS` 从环境里删掉了（2026-10-01 用 PEB 读运行中进程的真实环境块实测：主进程与宿主进程里都查不到它，日志里有 `Most NODE_OPTIONs are not supported in packaged apps.`） |
| 翻转 Electron fuse | ❌ 没有可翻的：`EnableNodeOptionsEnvironmentVariable` 出厂就是开着的（而且即便关的，Electron 依然会删） |
| 直接改 DSH 的 asar / 源码 | ❌ 升级就失效，而且动的是 DSH 自己的文件 |
| **写成 DSH 插件** | ✅ 插件由宿主自己加载、直接在宿主进程里执行；不改 DSH 任何文件；升级照样在 |

---

## 它到底能管到多少（如实说明，别指望过头）

- ✅ **打点是全覆盖的**：不管哪个模块、哪种写法，只要真在同步等子进程，就有"进入/返回"流水。
- ✅ **限时覆盖"调用时才取 `child_process.xxx`"的调用方**（CommonJS `require`、以及插件装好之后才加载的模块）。
- ❌ **限时管不到"已经绑定好"的 ESM 命名导入**：宿主里很多模块写的是
  `import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process"`，这种绑定在模块加载时就固定了；
  2026-10-01 实测（`_diag\esm-binding-test`）：事后替换 `child_process.spawnSync`，这类模块拿到的仍是原函数。
  **但这些调用照样会被记进流水**——所以哪怕限时管不到，你依然能知道是哪一次卡住的。
- ❌ 不抓内核态堆栈，也不自动杀进程：**只取证，不动手**（这是你定的规矩：卡死时先留证据）。

---

## 装在哪、怎么看

- 源码：`D:\数据库\dsh闲杂工作区\dsh-local-host-guard`
- 数据目录（日志/标记/报告都在这里）：`D:\dsh\_audit\guard\dsh-local-host-guard\`
  - `日志.log`：插件自己的日志（中文）
  - `当前同步调用.log`：**打点流水**（一行"进入"、一行"返回"，滚动清空，最大 256 KB）
  - `卡死报告\卡死-<时间戳>.json`：**卡死证据**（主线程停摆时由哨兵线程写出）
  - `node-reports\node-report-<时间戳>.json`：同时抓的 node 进程报告（各线程 JS 栈 / libuv 活动）
    > 这个目录名故意用纯 ASCII：2026-10-02 实测，node 自带的 `process.report.writeReport()` 在 Windows 上
    > **写不进含中文的路径**（`Failed to open Node.js report file: ... (errno: 2)`，哪怕目录存在）。
    > 插件自己用 `fs` 写的那些中文文件名不受影响。
  - `状态.json`：哨兵最近一次心跳状态（主线程是否正常、当前停摆多少毫秒）
  - `最近卡死报告.txt`：最新那份报告的路径，外部看门狗也能一眼找到
- 只读状态路由（仅本机回环可读，返回中文 JSON）：
  `http://127.0.0.1:19387/__dsh/host-guard/status`

### 命令行

```powershell
# 看状态：哨兵在不在岗、打点统计、最近流水、最近卡死报告
node D:\数据库\dsh闲杂工作区\dsh-local-host-guard\lib\cli.mjs --状态

# 只看打点流水尾部，以及"最后那次进了没回的调用"
node D:\数据库\dsh闲杂工作区\dsh-local-host-guard\lib\cli.mjs --标记

# 列出卡死报告并打印最新那份
node D:\数据库\dsh闲杂工作区\dsh-local-host-guard\lib\cli.mjs --报告

# 自测：在独立进程里故意让主线程死等几秒，看哨兵能不能落证据（默认 4000 毫秒）
node D:\数据库\dsh闲杂工作区\dsh-local-host-guard\lib\cli.mjs --自测卡死 4000
```

---

## 内存下放：让"活着但不活跃"的会话从宿主堆里退出（2026-10-05 新增）

背景见 `D:\数据库\dsh闲杂工作区\报告\DSH宿主内存崩溃-全量报告-20261005.md`：
宿主堆上限固定 4192 MB，撞顶就 `FATAL ERROR` 退出（退出码 134）。实测清楚了两件事——
**常驻内存由"事件流总量"决定，瞬时尖峰由"单个会话大小"决定**；崩前 2.7~3.2 GB 的活对象
**四枪全量 GC 只回收 7/9/11/20 MB**，也就是 GC 无效，只能减**活对象**。

`lib\下放.mjs` 干的就是这件事：把一个**闲置、没人在看、内容已经完整落盘**的活会话，
从宿主的 SessionStore 里**摘出去**（不是删数据，只是不再占内存）；客户端下次进入这个会话时，
DSH 会照常从磁盘把它读回来。

> **红线（第 12 章）**：不删任何数据、**永不写会话文件**、不改内核 asar、三大会话默认在保护名单里。
> 任何一步失败就中止，绝不做半途操作。

### 它怎么判断"可以下放"（每一步都是硬门槛）

```
定位会话文件 → await sessions.flush(会话) → 校验磁盘 → 强校验 → detachEntered(entry) → 复核 → 记流水
```

| 步骤 | 判据 | 不通过会怎样 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 找会话文件 | `<会话根>\<项目目录>\<会话id>\session.v4.jsonl.zstd` | 中止 |
| `flush(会话)` | 唯一持久化屏障；返回值=有没有 `session/flush` 监听者参与 | 抛错 ⇒ 中止 |
| 校验磁盘-字节账 | 只是**线索**（字节没变不代表磁盘旧：可能早就落过了） | 文件读不到/为空 ⇒ 中止 |
| **强校验** | 流式解压+数行，要求 **磁盘事件数 ≥ 内存事件数**（内存里每一条磁盘上都要有） | 不够 ⇒ 中止；**文件 > `下放强校验MB`（默认 64 MB）直接拒绝下放**，不冒丢数据的风险 |
| `detachEntered(entry)` | 实证签名：入参是 **entry** 不是 id | 没有 entry / 抛错 ⇒ 中止 |
| 复核 | 再取一次 entry，报"已不在内存表"才算生效 | 仍在表里 ⇒ 如实记"下放可能没生效" |

### 候选条件（全中才动手）

① 不是保护名单里的会话 ② 不在"最近最活跃"的那 N 个里（`下放排除最近活动`，默认 1）
③ 闲置 ≥ `下放闲置分钟`（默认 10）④ 事件数 ≥ `下放事件下限`（默认 500）
⑤ 在内存表里有活 entry，且 `appending` / `announcing` / `detachRequested` 都不是 true
⑥ 没在冷却期、没超"每次/每分钟"上限。

触发：定时扫描（默认 60 秒）｜内存压力（`heapUsed ≥ 下放阈值MB`，默认 2600 MB）｜手动
`GET http://127.0.0.1:19387/__dsh/host-guard/下放`。

### 怎么开（默认是关的，只报告不动作）

```json
// %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\host-guard.json
{
  "启用下放": true,
  "下放动作": "detach",
  "下放闲置分钟": 10,
  "下放事件下限": 500,
  "下放阈值MB": 2600
}
```

**杀开关**：`"启用下放": false`（立刻回到只报告）；`GET /__dsh/host-guard/arm`（带缓存破坏重装三个闸）。
**回滚**：删掉插件即可，原始方法本来就没被改（下放只调公开服务，不包装任何内核方法）。

### 可改的项（默认值）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `启用下放` | `false` | 总开关。false ⇒ **只报告**，一个都不动 |
| `下放动作` | `"只报告"` | 只有显式改成 `detach` 才真动手（`dispose` 已停用：它不移出内存却会关掉写句柄） |
| `下放闲置分钟` | `10` | 多久没动过才算闲置 |
| `下放事件下限` | `500` | 太小的会话不值得动 |
| `下放阈值MB` | `2600` | heapUsed 到这儿就算"有压力"，立即扫一轮 |
| `下放压力最小间隔毫秒` | `15000` | 两次压力扫描之间至少隔这么久 |
| `下放每次上限` | `1` | 一轮最多下放几个 |
| `下放每分钟上限` | `2` | 每分钟最多下放几个（防抖动） |
| `下放扫描间隔毫秒` | `60000` | 定时扫描间隔 |
| `下放冷却毫秒` | `600000` | 同一个会话多久内不再动 |
| `下放强校验MB` | `64` | 超过就**拒绝下放**（不是跳过校验） |
| `下放探针允许flush` | `false` | 探针默认只读；true 才真调一次 flush 比对前后字节账 |
| `下放排除最近活动` | `1` | 永远不动最近最活跃的这 N 个（多半正是你此刻在看的那个） |
| `下放保护名单` | 三大会话 | 数组或逗号串都行 |
| `下放会话根目录` | `%DSH_HOME%\sessions` | 一般不用改 |

### 已实证的接口语义（2026-10-05 从内核 asar 读出 + 自测固化）

1. `sessions.list()` 返回 **Session 对象数组**；`get(id)` 返回 Session。
2. `sessions.liveEntryFor(会话)` 入参是 **Session 对象**；活着返回 entry（含 `carrier`/`detach()`），
   **不活直接抛错**（`session "<id>" is not live in this store`）——所以"抛错"= 已经不在表里。
3. `sessions.detachEntered(entry)` 入参是 **entry**：`store.delete(id)` + `attachments.delete(session)`，
   announced 时**顺带**派发 `session/disposed`。不 flush、不删数据、不写文件。
4. `sessions.flush(会话)` 是唯一持久化屏障（内部要用 enter 时捕获的 carrier）；**detach 之后再 flush 必抛错**。
5. SessionStore 上**没有** `dispose` / `close` / `release` / `evict`（报告 10.2 写的 dispose 是笔误）。
6. 下放的代价（如实说）：detach 后该会话新事件**只留在内存、不再落盘**；`session/disposed` 会让
   持久化后端最终排空并**关闭写句柄**，客户端下次进入时由 DSH 自己重新取句柄从磁盘读回
   ——**这一步还没在真宿主里验证过**，所以第一版默认只报告。

### 配套路由

**路由名一律用 ASCII 主用名**（`status` / `arm` / `probe` / `offload`）。
原样中文名（`装闸` / `探针` / `下放`）和百分号编码名也各注册一份，只为兼容旧文档旧脚本——
2026-10-05 21:51 实测：**带中文的路径注册成功了、日志也写了"已注册"，但请求一律 404**
（同一个 handler、同一段代码注册的 `/__dsh/host-guard/status` 却 200）。原因多半是请求进来时
pathname 已被 URL 解析成百分号编码串（`%E6%8E%A2%E9%92%88`），跟注册表里的原样中文串对不上；
现在两种串都注册，且 ASCII 名没有这个歧义。

| 路由 | 干什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /__dsh/host-guard/status` | 多出 `下放` 字段：状态/模式/候选数/已下放/已跳过(带原因)/最近动作/下放前后 heapUsed/会话数/日志条数 |
| `GET /__dsh/host-guard/probe` | **只读**回答报告 10.3 的五个语义问题（读函数源码 + 实测 `liveEntryFor` + 磁盘账），不调 flush、不下放。**不读 3 秒内刚被写过的文件**（见文末事故记录）|
| `GET /__dsh/host-guard/offload` | 手动扫一轮（默认配置下就是 dry-run：只报告候选与跳过原因） |
| `GET /__dsh/host-guard/arm` | **重读 `host-guard.json` + 带 `?t=` 缓存破坏重新 import**，把回填闸 + 写闸 + 下放一起重装一遍（等效于重启，不用真重启）；响应里回显这次生效的配置 |

`/arm` **会先重读配置再装代码**，所以「改 `host-guard.json` → GET 一次 `/arm`」等效于「改配置 + 重启」——
报告 10.4 把这条列为**杀掉开关**（`{"启用下放": false}` 或 `{"下放动作": "只报告"}` 一改就生效）。
`lib\宿主接线自测.mjs` 的 ③b 段就是拿临时 `host-guard.json` 实测这件事的（改 777→888，不重启宿主直接生效）。

每次动作写一行 JSONL 到 `D:\dsh\_audit\guard\dsh-local-host-guard\下放.jsonl`（4 MB 轮转）。

### 装闸入口只有一个（2026-10-05 22:00 改动）

`回填闸.mjs` 以前会"搭便车"顺手把 `写闸.mjs`、`下放.mjs` 也装一遍（本意是让 `/arm` 一次重装三件套）。
实测后果：**两处都装 ⇒ 后装的那份把前一份

plugins.description: Compact floating Git project summary for DeepSeek Harness: branch, changes, commits and GitHub PR. Follows DSH themes and conversation bounds.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Project Summary

**在 DeepSeek Harness 对话窗口中，用一张悬浮卡片查看分支、变更、提交和 PR。**

[![CI](https://github.com/callqh/dsh-project-summary/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/callqh/dsh-project-summary/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2-informational.svg)](https://github.com/callqh/dsh-project-summary/releases)

简体中文 · [English](README.en.md)

一个第三方、只读的 DSH 插件。概要悬浮在**当前对话区域的右上角**，不占用整列、不替换现有右侧栏。侧栏打开、关闭或调整宽度时，卡片跟随对话区域移动；背景、文字和边框直接继承 DSH 客户端的深浅主题。

> 初始适配版本：**DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**。实际集成基于 macOS 桌面版；其他 DSH 版本和 Windows 尚未验证。开发测试可在 Linux CI 中运行。本项目与 DeepSeek / OpenAI 无官方关联，界面文案目前为中文。

## 预览

| 深色主题 · 右侧栏已打开 | 浅色主题 · 右侧栏已打开 |
| --- | --- |
| ![深色悬浮项目概要](assets/preview-dark.png) | ![浅色悬浮项目概要](assets/preview-light.png) |

*以上为组件演示截图，使用模拟布局、主题变量和虚构仓库 / PR 数据，不是真实会话截图。实际内容来自当前项目。*

## 功能

- **项目与分支**：仓库名称、当前分支、游离 HEAD，以及相对本地 upstream 的领先 / 落后提交数。
- **工作区变更**：修改文件数、增加 / 删除行数；点击「变更」打开只读 diff 预览。
- **拉取请求**：GitHub 当前分支关联的 PR 标题、编号、状态、目标分支和外链，优先显示开放 PR。
- **最近提交**：最近三条提交的短 hash、说明、作者和日期。
- **轻量悬浮**：展开宽度约 296px，可收起；记住收起状态，窄屏初次打开默认收起。
- **主题与布局**：自动跟随 DSH 深浅主题；概要留在对话区域，不覆盖右侧工具栏。
- **自动刷新**：展开时每 15 秒查询本地 Git；PR 缓存 60 秒；页面不可见时暂停读取。
- **只读与降级**：不提交、不推送、不切分支、不初始化仓库。没有 Git 仓库、没有 PR 或 gh 不可用时显示提示。

## 快速安装

### 1. 下载预构建插件

前往 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/callqh/dsh-project-summary/releases/latest)，下载：

```text
dsh-project-summary-0.1.1.tgz
```

发布包已包含 Host 与 Client 构建产物，**无需允许运行安装脚本**。

### 2. 通过 DSH 插件管理器安装并启用

在 DSH 中向 Agent 发送：

```text
请用 plugin_manager 安装并启用这个插件 bundle：
https://github.com/callqh/dsh-project-summary/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-project-summary-0.1.1.tgz
```

如果你已经下载到本地，也可以提供 tarball 的绝对路径。对应工具参数示例：

```json
{
  "action": "install_bundle",
  "target": "https://github.com/callqh/dsh-project-summary/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-project-summary-0.1.1.tgz",
  "enabled": true
}
```

这是 **DSH 工具参数**，不是终端命令。根据当前权限设置，DSH 可能要求批准。安装和启用会影响当前 profile 下的所有会话。

### 3. 加载新版本

按插件管理器返回的结果操作：

- `applied`：刷新当前 DSH 页面，让新的 Client bundle 加载。
- `restart-required`：**退出并重新打开 DSH**，仅刷新页面可能仍然使用旧版本。

打开使用 Git 仓库目录的主会话即可看到概要。插件没有额外必填配置，不会修改 DSH 原有侧栏。

> npm registry 暂未发布；请使用 GitHub Release tarball，不要直接运行 `npm install dsh-project-summary`。

## 可选：显示 GitHub PR

本地分支、变更与提交只需要 `git`。PR 查询额外需要安装 [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/)，并在 **DSH Host 所使用的环境**中完成登录：

```bash
gh auth login
gh auth status
```

插件只查询 `origin` 指向的 **GitHub.com** 仓库，支持 HTTPS、`git@github.com:` 和 `ssh://git@github.com/` 地址。支持开放、已合并和已关闭 PR；多个匹配结果中优先选开放 PR。暂不支持 GitLab、GitHub Enterprise 或自定义远程名称。

缺少 gh、未登录、权限不足或网络不可用时，PR 区域显示提示，**不影响本地 Git 信息**。插件不会触发登录，也不会读取或展示 token。

## 统计口径与限制

| 内容 | 口径 |
| --- | --- |
| 当前项目 | 已载入主会话的 Host 工作目录；沿父目录查找 Git 仓库 |
| 变更行数 | 相对 `HEAD` 的最终工作区内容，包含已暂存和未暂存修改；不是本次 AI 回合的修改量 |
| 未跟踪文件 | 仅显示名称，不读取内容、不计行数；未跟踪目录按 Git `--untracked-files=normal` 的汇总显示 |
| 尚无提交 | 显示已暂存修改；提交记录为空 |
| 二进制文件 | 单独计数，不按文本行统计 |
| 领先 / 落后 | 对比本地已知 upstream；不会自动 `fetch`，无 upstream 时为 0 |
| Diff 预览 | 已跟踪文件，最多 100,000 字符；不含未跟踪文件内容 |
| 大仓库 | 单次命令最多 8 秒、输出最多 2 MB，超限时提示失败 |
| 刷新 | 本地概要有 4 秒短缓存；PR 最多每分钟查询一次，手动刷新同样遵守 PR 缓存 |

## 安全与隐私

- 不使用 shell 拼接执行命令；只运行固定的只读 Git / gh 查询。
- Git 读取关闭 fsmonitor、hooks、外部 diff、textconv、pager 和 optional locks。
- 浏览器只传会话 ID，不接受任意磁盘路径。
- 无遥测、独立数据库或凭据存储；localStorage 只记住卡片收起状态。
- 安装意味着信任 Host 插件读取项目及使用现有 gh 凭据联网查询，**不等于为不可信仓库提供沙箱**。

完整说明与私密漏洞报告方式见 [安全策略](SECURITY.md)。请勿将真实 token、私有仓库内容或未脱敏日志提交到公开 Issue。

## 常见问题

**安装后没有卡片？** 先检查是否已启用，是否需要重启，是否处于已有工作目录的主会话。设置页不会展示卡片；不兼容 DSH 版本可能缺少所需的 Slot 或布局标记。

**打开右侧栏会挡住概要吗？** 概要根据对话区域的实际边界定位，不按整个窗口的右边缘定位。它不占用整列；狭窄窗口可收起卡片。

**切换系统主题没有变化？** 卡片跟随的是 **DSH 当前主题**，不是独立监听系统主题。当 DSH 选择「跟随系统」时，概要也随 DSH 一起切换。

**为什么没有关联 PR？** 检查 `origin` 是否为 GitHub.com、当前分支是否有 PR，以及 DSH Host 环境中的 `gh auth status`。PR 缓存最多保留一分钟。

**怎么停用 / 卸载？** 通过 DSH 插件管理器对 `dsh-project-summary` 执行 `set_bundle`（`enabled: false`）或 `remove_bundle`。按返回结果刷新或重启。

## 开发与贡献

需要 Node.js **22.18+** 和 Git，无需另一个 DSH 项目提供依赖：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/callqh/dsh-project-summary.git
cd dsh-project-summary
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run check
npx playwright install chromium
npm run test:ui
npm pack --ignore-scripts
```

`npm run check` 包含类型检查、构建、Git 测试和发布包检查。UI 测试使用模拟 RPC / 主题 / 布局，不启动新的 DSH 服务、不改动用户 profile。源代码及预构建产物均在仓库中。

欢迎提交 [Issue](https://github.com/callqh/dsh-project-summary/issues) 或 Pull Request。目录结构和贡献规范见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，版本记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 callqh。可以使用、修改和再分发；请保留许可证声明。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tavern-extras

DSH Tavern 的附加功能，不改作者的代码。

## 编辑上一条发言

游玩会话输入框上方的「编辑上一条发言」：调用作者原有的「回退本轮」（正文、变量、状态一起回退，可用「撤销回退」恢复），再把上一条发言原文填回输入框，改完发送即重新生成。

- 只在游玩会话出现，卡片对话和 silly 对话不出现。
- 最后一轮生成失败时，第一次点击只清掉失败回复并交回那条输入；再点一次才编辑上一轮。
- 原发言里的图片/附件不会带回。

## 写作模式

左侧栏「游玩 / 卡片」旁边多了「写作」。写作模式下列表区换成「项目 → 对话」：

- 项目放在酒馆资源目录下：`DSH-Tavern/data/harness/profile-data/tavern/data/resources/novel/<书名>/`，每个项目一套约定目录（大纲、设定、伏笔账本、点子、正文、摘要……），项目设置在 `.novel/project.json`。
- 项目旁的「＋」新建对话，「⚙」打开右侧栏的「项目设置」。打开写作项目里的对话时会自动切到写作模式。
- 对话使用「长篇写作」agent preset（`presets/novel/`）：九个写作 Skill、子 agent 分工检索与审查、计划模式、上下文压缩。另外可用酒馆「Skill 库」里你自己的 Skill，以及项目里 `.dsh/skills/` 下的 Skill。项目根目录的 `AGENTS.md` 会自动进入上下文。

### 项目设置（右侧栏）

- **额外素材路径**：已有的小说、设定集、资料所在的文件夹或文件。AI 在这个项目里默认可以读取（只读）。「＋ 选择文件夹」弹出系统自带的文件夹对话框；用手机远程访问时退回页面内浏览。
- **写作预设**：从酒馆「预设库」选一个预设，读取它启用的条目（与「应用到本局」相同的取法）存进项目，作为文风要求交给 AI。预设库里改了开关后点「重新读取」。

这两项在每次请求时附在系统提示末尾，改完下一条消息就生效。

### 写作 Agent（右侧栏「其他」分组）

对所有写作项目生效：

- **主提示词**（默认 `presets/novel/persona.md`）和 **九个 Skill**（默认 `presets/novel/skills/`）：可编辑、查看默认、恢复默认。改过的版本存在 `resources/novel/.agent/`（`persona.md`、`skills/<名>/SKILL.md`），同名时优先于默认版本；插件更新只换默认版本。
- **流程设置**（`resources/novel/.agent/settings.json`）：写完一章是否自动审查、审查方向、每章目标字数、子 agent 模型。转成「写作流程设置」一节放在主提示词后面。子 agent 模型只能从 DSH 设置「子 agent 模型选择」里允许的路由中选。
- 主提示词和流程设置由插件在每次组装时放在系统提示最前面，Skill 由 DSH 每次加载时重读，所以改完下一条消息就生效。计划模式的规则仍在 `agent.cordis.yml` 里，改它需要重启。

### 与 dsh-tavern 共存

- 左侧栏：酒馆把侧栏注册在 `sidebar.workspaces`（priority -1）。本插件以 priority -2 注册一个外壳，在里面原样渲染酒馆的侧栏，再把「写作」按钮和写作面板挂进它的 DOM（依赖 `.dsh-tavern-sidebar`、`.dsh-tavern-mode-switch` 等类名）。
- system 组装：dsh-tavern 的钩子会替换非酒馆会话的提示词段落、去掉文件/Skill/子 agent 等工具。本插件对写作项目会话（工作目录里有 `.novel/project.json`）把它们补回来，其他插件新增的内容保留。最里层钩子在启动约 3 秒后登记；启动后立刻在写作会话里发出的第一条请求可能还没有补回。
- 系统文件夹对话框复用 DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native`；桌面端宿主跑在 Electron utility 进程里，调用期间临时设置 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，否则它会把对话框子进程启动成第二个桌面程序。

## 安装

已在 DSH Tavern 2.5.0（DSH 0.1.5-rc.2，Windows 桌面版）上使用。下面的 `<DSH Tavern>` 指 DSH Tavern 的安装目录（里面有 `DSH Tavern.exe` 和 `data` 文件夹）。

1. 把本仓库克隆到 DSH Tavern 安装目录**之外**的任意位置，例如 `D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-tavern-extras`（放在外面，升级时不会被清掉）。
2. 关闭 DSH Tavern，编辑 `<DSH Tavern>\data\harness\profiles\tavern\package.json`：
   - 在 `dependencies` 里加一行 `"dsh-tavern-extras": "link:D:/dsh-plugins/dsh-tavern-extras"`（换成你的路径，用正斜杠）；
   - 在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾加上 `"dsh-tavern-extras"`。
3. 建立链接（PowerShell）：
   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path "<DSH Tavern>\data\harness\profiles\tavern\node_modules\dsh-tavern-extras" -Target "D:\dsh-plugins\dsh-tavern-extras"
   ```
4. 启动 DSH Tavern。

DSH Tavern 升级时会保留你自己加的 bundle 和依赖。卸载：删掉 `package.json` 里加的两处和上面的链接，再重启。

改了插件代码或 `cordis.patch.yml` 之后需要重启 DSH Tavern；只改前端（`lib/client.js`）时按 Ctrl+R 刷新即可。

## 注意

本插件不改 dsh-tavern 的代码，但依赖它的一些内部结构（见下文）。dsh-tavern 升级后如果这些结构变了，插件可能失效。设计上失效时尽量原样放行，不影响酒馆本身；遇到问题请开 issue 并注明 DSH Tavern 版本。

## 依赖 dsh-tavern / DSH 内部结构的地方

- `/api/dsh-tavern/rollbackTurn`、`listPresets`、`getPreset` 的返回结构
- 窗口事件 `dsh-tavern-data-changed`；侧栏类名（见上）
- `lib/domain/native-conversation-storage.js`、`data/sessions.json`
- `system-prompt/assemble` 钩子的行为（见上）

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zcode-coding-plan

**中文** · [English](README.en.md) · [Release notes](https://github.com/yuyang2230/dsh-zcode-coding-plan/releases)

[![CI](https://github.com/yuyang2230/dsh-zcode-coding-plan/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/yuyang2230/dsh-zcode-coding-plan/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-5FA04E)](https://nodejs.org)
[![ZCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/ZCode-3.x-8A2BE2)](https://zcode.z.ai/cn/docs)

**买了 GLM Coding Plan，却只在别的客户端里用？** 这个 DSH 桌面端插件让那份已付费的套餐额度，
在 DeepSeek Harness 会话里真正发挥作用——把编码重活派给官方 ZCode 通道，享受 **1.5 倍（150%）**额度，
外加原生 Agent 能力（文件 / Bash / MCP）与多轮会话。

![直连 API Key 与经 ZCode 官方 CLI 的对比](docs/assets/comparison.svg)

> 合规驱动官方 ZCode 客户端，**不修改客户端、不伪造请求、不绕过任何限制**。

**注册两个工具：**

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `zcode_call` | 派一个真实 agent 任务给套餐通道，支持 `--resume` 多轮续接 |
| `zcode_quota` | 查套餐余量；配合内置闸门做到「余量够才自动派活」 |

**先看对比，再决定要不要装** ↓

---

## 为什么用它：直连 API Key vs 本插件

同一个 GLM Coding Plan 套餐 Key，两种花法，结果差很远。

| 维度 | 直连 API Key（自己调 `open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic`） | 本插件（经 ZCode 官方 CLI） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **计费口径** | 扣**账户余额**（按量付费，与套餐无关） | 扣**套餐积分**（你已付费的订阅额度） |
| **ZCode 渠道倍率** | 不适用——非官方指定工具，无倍率概念 | **1.5 倍（150%）**套餐额度消耗 |
| **前置条件** | 任意智谱 API Key 即可 | 需装 **ZCode 客户端** + 有 **GLM Coding Plan 订阅** |
| **Agent 能力** | 纯 LLM 调用，只有模型本身的读写/执行能力 | 原生**文件 / Bash / MCP / Hooks**，是完整 agent |
| **多轮续接** | 自己实现会话状态，自己管重试与上下文裁剪 | 原生 `--resume <sessionId>`，客户端负责 |
| **上下文缓存** | 无 | **支持**（实测 cacheReadTokens 命中约 13K–68K） |
| **凭证管理** | 你自己在代码里塞 Key | Key 交给官方客户端，本插件只做路由 |
| **可审计性** | 无内建记录 | ZCode 本地 `db.sqlite` 逐条记录 provider/model/token |
| **故障面** | 自己维护 | 依赖 ZCode 客户端版本（升级可能改 schema） |

更详细的计费与能力矩阵见 **[docs/comparison.md](docs/comparison.md)**。

### 什么时候值得

- 你**已经买了** GLM Coding Plan，但 DSH 这边没在用 → 套餐在闲置，本插件让它干活；
- 你想把**多文件重构 / 跑测试 / 批量修改**这类重活外包出去，不想让它们吃主会话额度；
- 你看重**可审计**（每次调用 provider、model、token 都有本地记录）。

### 什么时候不值得

- **你没有 Coding Plan 订阅** → 装了无效果，白折腾。直连 API Key 按量扣余额也完全能用。
- 你只想要**一次性的短问答** → 起 ZCode 子进程要背约 66K tokens 的系统提示，比裸 API 调用重得多。
- 你**不接受**在机器上多装一个 Electron 客户端 → 本插件依赖它。

### 快速判断：装之前问自己三句

1. 我**已经订阅**了 GLM Coding Plan 吗？（没有 → 跳过本插件）
2. 我平时主要在 **DSH** 里干活，而不是 ZCode 客户端里？（是 → 插件有用）
3. 我有重活（多文件重构 / 跑测试 / 批量修改）想外包吗？（有 → 直接收益）

三个都是「是」再往下看安装。

---

## 安装（3 步）

### 0. 前置：装 ZCode，并准备好套餐 Key

1. 安装 **ZCode 官方客户端**：<https://zcode.z.ai/cn/docs/install>
2. 在智谱平台开通 **GLM Coding Plan**，拿到套餐 API Key。
3. 把 Key 放进 DSH 凭据文件 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 段（**插件不附带任何 Key**，也没有 Key 就无法工作）：

   ```yaml
   refs:
     BIGMODEL_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY: 你的套餐Key
   ```

### 1. 放插件并注册

把仓库放到你机器上的任意目录，例如 `C:/tools/dsh-zcode-coding-plan`。

**A) 注册到 DSH profile** —— 编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`，在顶层列表追加：

```yaml
    - id: zcode-coding-plan
      name: dsh-zcode-coding-plan
      config:
        # 下面三行可以整个省略 —— 插件会自动探测 ZCode 安装位置
        # zcodeExe: 'D:/Program Files/ZCode/ZCode.exe'
        # zcodeCjs: 'D:/Program Files/ZCode/resources/glm/zcode.cjs'
        # builtinProviderConfig: 'D:/Program Files/ZCode/resources/config/provider/zcode-builtin.json'
        providerOverride: 'C:/Users/你的用户名/.dsh/zcode-provider-override.json'
        defaultMode: yolo
        defaultTimeoutMs: 900000
        # 余量闸门可选：填脚本路径才有闸门；留空则直接派活（fail-open）
        quotaScript: ''
```

> 编辑前先备份（`cordis.patch.yml.bak-<用途>-<时间戳>`）——运行中的 DSH 可能改写它。

**B) 加依赖** —— 在 DSH 应用目录的 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里追加：

```json
    "dsh-zcode-coding-plan": "link:C:/tools/dsh-zcode-coding-plan"
```

**C) 建 junction** —— 在 DSH 应用目录执行：

```bash
node -e "require('fs').symlinkSync('C:/tools/dsh-zcode-coding-plan', require('path').join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','dsh-zcode-coding-plan'), 'junction')"
```

> 用 `link:` + junction，不要用 `cp` 复制——复制后插件改动不会生效。

### 2. 生成 provider 覆盖配置 + 自检

```bash
cd C:/tools/dsh-zcode-coding-plan
node scripts/generate-override.mjs   # 读 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml，写 ~/.dsh/zcode-provider-override.json
node scripts/setup-check.mjs          # 环境自检，退出码 0 = 就绪
```

或者用 `node scripts/install.mjs` 一步打印上面所有片段（含本机探测到的真实路径）。

最后**重启 DSH 桌面端**。日志里应出现：

```
[dsh-zcode-coding-plan] tools zcode_call + zcode_quota registered; zcode=… cjs=… override=… probe=windows-paths
```

---

## 用法

### 自然语言触发

跟 agent 这么说就会走本插件：

- 「用 zcode 跑这个重构」「把编码任务派给 ZCode」
- 「省 DSH 额度」「吃 150% 配额」
- 「让 GLM Coding Plan 干这个重活」

agent 会先 `zcode_quota` 查余量，再决定是否 `zcode_call` 派活。

### `zcode_call` 参数

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt` | string | ✅ | 派给 GLM 的任务提示词，写清目标与验收标准 |
| `cwd` | string | | 任务工作目录；绝对路径或相对会话目录；省略 = 会话工作目录 |
| `resume` | string | | 上次返回的 `sessionId`，续接多轮会话 |
| `mode` | string | | `build`/`edit`/`plan`/`yolo`，默认 `yolo`（全自动）；仅咨询用 `plan` |
| `timeout_ms` | number | | 子进程超时，默认 900000（15 分钟），钳制到 [30000, 3600000] |
| `force` | boolean | | `true` 跳过余量闸门强行执行（默认 false，余量不足返回 `quota_insufficient`） |

**返回**

```json
{
  "sessionId": "sess_…",
  "traceId": "…",
  "response": "…",
  "usage": { "inputTokens": 67512, "outputTokens": 4, "totalTokens": 67516 },
  "projection": { "contextWindow": 200000, "contextUsed": 67516 },
  "exitCode": 0
}
```

失败时返回 `{ error, hint?, timedOut?, timeoutMs?, exitCode?, stderrTail? }`。

### `zcode_quota` 参数

无参数。返回套餐余量与路由判定：

```json
{
  "available": true,
  "sufficient": true,
  "plan": "pro",
  "windowPct": 4.3, "routeWindowPct": 60,
  "weekPct": 16.0,  "routeWeekPct": 80
}
```

`available:false` 表示没配置余量脚本（正常状态，闸门会 fail-open 直接放行）。

### 多轮示例

```
1. zcode_call({ "prompt": "在 src/ 下新增一个 Express 服务并写好 README", "cwd": "D:/work/myproj" })
   → response: …, sessionId: "sess_124bfb13-fc98-42c4-8056-f0b3aa584bed"

2. zcode_call({ "prompt": "接着把测试补齐，跑到全绿", "cwd": "D:/work/myproj",
                "resume": "sess_124bfb13-fc98-42c4-8056-f0b3aa584bed" })

3. zcode_call({ "prompt": "评估要不要上 gRPC", "cwd": "D:/work/myproj",
                "resume": "sess_124bfb13-…", "mode": "plan" })   // 只讨论，不动文件
```

---

## 余量闸门（可选）

闸门在派活前跑一次本地余量估算脚本，**5h 窗口 < 60% 且本周 < 80% 才放行**，否则快速返回 `quota_insufficient`（不消耗任何额度、不启动子进程）。

**默认不启用**——发布版不预设任何人的监控脚本路径。配置 `quotaScript` 才生效；缺失/异常/超时一律 fail-open 放行。

脚本契约（任何满足此约定的程序都可以）：

```
<python> <quotaScript> --json --plan <plan>
→ stdout: {"plan":"pro","window_weighted":5,"window_cap":400,
           "week_weighted":308,"weekly_cap":2000}
```

结果缓存 60 秒，避免一个会话里反复起 python。强制执行用 `force: true`。

---

## 验证调用真的走了套餐

ZCode 把每次调用记在本地 `~/.zcode/cli/db/db.sqlite`（约 440MB，务必**只读**打开）：

```bash
python -c "
import sqlite3
```

# dsh-archive-check — Archive filing register completeness and retention period check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-archive-check` reads one 归档登记表 (filing register) — the items with the columns the register carries, plus the fonds and the year it covers — and checks what a register can be held to mechanically: that each item carries the description fields you configure, that 档号 is unique within the register, that 件号 runs without gaps, that 保管期限 uses a term from your own schedule, that 形成日期 parses and matches the register's year, and that items past the transfer deadline you configure are surfaced.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-archive-check: real output over its AR-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-archive-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-archive-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `AR-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| I have configured no required description fields. Is the description check passing silently? | No. While `requiredFields` is empty, `AR-001` reports itself in `skipped`, so an empty difference list is not read as “nothing is missing”. Once you list your own column names, it checks only that each field is filled on every item — an empty string counts as unfilled — and it does not judge whether the description is accurate. |
| Two items carry the same 档号, but one of them has a space in the middle. Is that still a duplicate? | Yes. `AR-002` compares 档号 ignoring whitespace, so 「A-2026-001」 and 「A-2026- 001」 count as the same number. It is capped at `warn` because the clause it cites states uniqueness as a compilation principle rather than as a verbatim ban on duplicates in one register, and a hit usually means duplicate registration or a mistyped 档号 that a person still has to confirm. |
| The 保管期限 column says something our retention schedule does not list. What does the check report? | `AR-003` keeps two cases apart: a value the parser cannot read as a retention term at all (it recognises 「永久」, 「长期」, 「定期N年」 and 「N年」), and a recognisable term that is not in the `retentionTerms` list you configure. The two need different corrections, so they are reported as different messages. The rule never decides which retention period a document deserves, and a period longer than the national framework is not an error — the provisions the pack cites make the enterprise figures a minimum. |
| The 件号 run 1, 2, 4 — is the missing 3 reported? | Yes, but only for 件号 written as pure digits: `AR-004` checks continuity only for those; a 件号 containing letters or spaces is left out of the comparison and reports no difference at all. A gap is not by itself a defect — the number may simply be unused — so a hit only asks you to confirm whether an item went unregistered. With `checkSequence: false` the rule does not run. |
| The 形成日期 is written 「二〇二六年三月十五日」. Will that be read? | No. `AR-005` reports it as “cannot parse”, which is a different message from a date whose year disagrees with the register's year — the two point at different corrections. Filing across year boundaries is allowed, and the rule does not decide which year a document should be filed under. |
| How does the check know that a transfer is due? | `AR-007` compares each item's 形成日期 with the `transferAfterYears` you configure and reports only whether that deadline has already passed under the years you set. The parameter ships as `0`, meaning unconfigured, so the rule reports itself in `skipped` until you set it; with `requireFormedAt: true`, items that have no 形成日期 are reported separately, because no due date can be worked out from a missing date. The rule does not judge whether a transfer should be brought forward or postponed. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《归档文件整理规则》 | DA/T 22—2015 | AR-001, AR-002, AR-004, AR-005, AR-006 |
| 《中华人民共和国档案法实施条例》 | 国务院令第772号 | AR-001, AR-003, AR-007 |
| 《机关文件材料归档范围和文书档案保管期限规定》 | 国家档案局令第8号 | AR-003 |
| 《企业文件材料归档范围和档案保管期限规定》 | 国家档案局令第10号 | AR-003 |
| 《中华人民共和国档案法》 | 2020年修订（主席令第四十七号） | AR-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks one **归档登记表** (filing register) for the things a register can be
held to mechanically — that each item is described completely enough to be filed and found again, that
档号 is unique, that 件号 runs without gaps, that retention terms come from your schedule, and that
形成日期 parses and matches the register's year. It does **not** decide whether a particular document
belonged in the archive, nor which retention period it deserves. Those are the archivist's judgements.

> ### ⚠️ Three things this plugin refuses to do, and why
>
> **1. It never decides which retention period a document deserves.** There is **no single national
> retention table** you can apply. 《档案法实施条例》第十九条第二款 and 国家档案局令第8号第十二条 require each
> institution to compile its own 归档范围 and 保管期限表 and have it approved by the档案 authority; and
> 国家档案局令第10号第十一条 says the enterprise figures are a **minimum** — an enterprise may lawfully
> choose a *longer* period. So `AR-003` checks only that the wording is one you have configured, and a
> test asserts that the pack says a longer period "is not an error".
>
> **2. It puts the transfer years where they belong.** The 20-year / 10-year figures are in
> **《档案法实施条例》第二十条第二款**, keyed to the *receiving archive's level*, not to whether the unit
> is an enterprise. 《档案法》第十五条 contains **no year figure at all** — it says only "按照国家有关规定，
> 定期". Attributing "满20年" to the law's article 15 would be fabrication, and a test asserts the pack
> does not.
>
> **3. It does not use the outdated first article.** 国家档案局令第8号's 第一条 cites the 1999
> 《档案法实施办法》, which the 2024 条例 (国务院令第772号) repealed in its 第五十二条. The pack never cites it,
> and a test asserts that.
>
> Two lists are yours, not the law's: the required description fields (`AR-001`) and your retention
> vocabulary (`AR-003`). Both ship **empty**, and a rule whose list is unset reports itself in `skipped`
> rather than passing silently.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a year's registers use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `archive_check` tool. It reads one register — items with the columns the register carries,
plus the fonds and year it covers — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AR-001` | each item carries your required description fields (off by default) | info | local |
| `AR-002` | 档号 is unique within the register | warn | principle |
| `AR-003` | 保管期限 uses a term from your schedule (off by default) | info | local |
| `AR-004` | 件号 is unique and gap-free within the register | warn | principle |
| `AR-005` | 形成日期 parses, and its year matches the register's year | warn | principle |
| `AR-006` | the register declares its fonds and year | warn | principle |
| `AR-007` | items past your configured transfer deadline (off by default) | info | local |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-archive-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-archive-check'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/archive-check.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `skipped` reason |
| `timeoutM

# dsh-permit-report-check — Administrative licensing application register completeness and date consistency check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-permit-report-check` reads one 行政许可办理台账 — the applicant header plus one row per application item — and checks that register's own closed loop and internal consistency: that each item listed in the 申请材料 column records whether it was submitted, that 受理日期 does not fall after 决定日期, that 决定日期 falls between 受理日期 and the 承诺办结日 the register itself records, that 决定结果 comes from the vocabulary you configured, that a record whose 决定结果 marks a grant carries its 许可证号, that the header names its 申请人 and 申请事项, and that no 许可事项 is registered twice in the table.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-permit-report-check: real output over its PR-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permit-report-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-permit-report-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `PR-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row lists materials in 申请材料, but 已提交材料 is blank — is that reported? | Yes. `PR-001` requires a `submittedItems` value on every row whose 申请材料 cell is filled, and reports the row when the submission column is empty. It reads the register's own materials column and checks only whether the submission is recorded: it does not compare that list with the matter's service guide, and does not judge whether the materials submitted are complete or compliant. If no row has a filled 申请材料 cell, the rule reports itself in `skipped`. |
| 受理日期 is later than 决定日期 — will that be caught? | Yes. `PR-002` compares the two dates the register itself carries, `acceptedAt` against `decidedAt`, treats the same day as not later, and reports the row where acceptance follows the decision. It only compares those two dates: it does not judge whether the acceptance was lawful or whether the application should have been accepted. A date it cannot parse is reported as its own finding rather than skipped silently. |
| What happens when the 承诺办结日 column is empty — and is the 法定时限 column checked at all? | `PR-003` reports itself in `skipped`: no day count is built in, because statutory periods are counted in working days, may be extended and may exclude hearing or expert-review time, so the only baseline is the 承诺办结日 (`dueAt`) the register states. No rule reads the 法定时限 (`legalDays`) column. When `dueAt` is filled, the rule checks that 决定日期 falls between 受理日期 and it; a finding means the decision disagrees with the deadline you recorded, never that it was late. |
| I wrote 补正后准予 into 决定结果. Is that accepted? | `PR-004` checks 决定结果 against the vocabulary in its `values` parameter, and that parameter ships empty — so as delivered the rule reports itself in `skipped` instead of judging your wording. Fill `values` with the outcomes your institution records (for example 不予受理) and any value not on that list is reported. The rule checks only whether the value is on the list; it does not judge whether the decision is correct or lawful. |
| A record says 准予 but the 许可证号 column is blank. | `PR-005` reports it: when 决定结果 matches a grant marker — `conditionValues`, by default 准予 / 准予许可 / 通过 / 同意 / 已办结 / 批准 — the record must carry its 许可证号 (`certificateNo`). It checks only that the number is filled in, not whether the certificate is genuine, valid or served. With no row matching a grant marker, the rule reports itself in `skipped`. |
| The same 许可事项 appears in two rows. | `PR-007` reports the later row and names the row it duplicates, because two registrations of one matter make the deadline check ambiguous. It checks uniqueness only, and a hit needs human confirmation: one project applying for several matters may legitimately look the same, so distinguish it in the materials column rather than deleting the row. Differences in whitespace are ignored; with no 许可事项 column the rule reports itself in `skipped`. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国行政许可法》 | 现行版本与条号本次未核实 | PR-001, PR-002, PR-005, PR-006, PR-007 |
| 各事项办事指南与承诺时限（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为台账写明的承诺办结日）—— ⚠️ 法定上限见《行政许可法》第四十二条，本条不引用该条 | PR-003 |
| 本机构许可办理管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的结果口径）—— ⚠️ 法定决定类型见《行政许可法》第三十八条，本条不引用该条 | PR-004 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **行政许可办理台账** for the closed loop a register can be held to — that each
application item records its submission, that acceptance does not follow the decision, that the decision falls
between acceptance and the promised completion date, that the decision outcome comes from your vocabulary, that a
grant records its certificate number, that the register names its applicant and matter, and that matters are not
double-registered. It does **not** decide whether a permit decision was lawful, whether the materials were
complete or compliant, whether an application should be accepted, or whether a permit should be granted.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately does not judge
>
> **It does not check whether the materials list is complete.** It reads the register's **own** 申请材料 column
> and checks that each listed item records whether it was submitted — **not** whether that list matches the
> matter's service guide. Verifying the list means comparing it against the guide, which this plugin does not do.
>
> **No statutory period is built in — and the statute says why that is the right call.**
> 《中华人民共和国行政许可法》was read verbatim (see `rules/evidence/clause-verification.md`), and three of its
> provisions make a built-in number unusable: **article 82 requires statutory periods to be counted in working
> days, excluding public holidays**; article 42 sets twenty days with a ten-day extension (forty-five plus
> fifteen for joint handling); and article 45 excludes time needed for hearings, testing, inspection and expert
> review from the period altogether. A register normally records calendar dates, so `PR-003` compares the decision
> date against the **promised completion date written in the register**, and reports itself in `skipped` when that
> column is empty. A finding means "this disagrees with the deadline you recorded", never "this was late".
>
> ⚠️ **The text read was the 2003 promulgation**; a 2019 amendment exists and **was not obtained**, so the pack
> keeps the note 「现行版本与条号本次未核实」 on every rule and claims no article is current law.
>
> **The outcome vocabulary ships empty.** Wording for grants, refusals and terminations varies by institution
> and matter, so `PR-004` reports itself in `skipped` until you configure it, and `PR-005` (which requires a
> certificate number once a grant is recorded) uses a configurable set of grant marker values rather than a
> built-in list.
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The
> regime lives in 《中华人民共和国行政许可法》 and in each matter's service guide. The verification pass could
> not retrieve verbatim clause text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and keeps every
> rule at `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the real clause and
> raise `kind` to `direct`.**

| Surface | Status |

| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a caseload use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `permit_report_check` tool. It reads one permit register — the applicant header plus one row per
application item — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |

| `PR-001` | each li
